dispatch.collectives: RCCL ring; validate PCIe P2P before Infinity Fabric

objective.description: Forward-port and optimize ROCm 10.x features for gfx906 before accepting a permanent fallback or exclusion.
objective.decision_rule: An upstream gfx906 deny-list is provisional until a source audit, code-generation check, and hardware correctness test show that the feature cannot be implemented safely on Vega20.

components.name: linux-amdgpu-kfd
components.notes: Use upstream/inbox or AMD Linux driver; do not fork first.

components.name: linux-firmware-vega20
components.notes: Binary firmware remains required.

components.name: llvm-amdgpu
components.notes: Emit real gfx906 code objects.

components.name: rocr-runtime
components.notes: Validate ISA and feature enumeration.

components.name: hip-runtime-comgr
components.notes: No HSA override permitted.

components.name: opencl-runtime
components.notes: Optional ocl-clr/ICD path; disabled in the minimal builder unless MI50_ENABLE_OPENCL=ON and host OpenGL development packages are present.

components.name: rocminfo-amdsmi
components.notes: Diagnostics and ECC/RAS visibility.

components.name: rocBLAS-Tensile
components.notes: Require Vega20/gfx906 library assets; FP16/FP32/FP64 are covered by the main smoke, while INT8->INT32 rocblas_gemm_ex is isolated as validate-per-kernel; missing/unloadable data returns NOT_IMPLEMENTED instead of aborting.

components.name: hipBLAS
components.notes: Route gfx906 to rocBLAS; never require hipBLASLt.

components.notes: Build device code for gfx906.

components.name: rocSPARSE
components.notes: Validate non-hipSPARSELt paths.

components.notes: Build device code for gfx906.

components.notes: Build device code for gfx906.

components.notes: Validate wave64 behavior.

components.name: MIOpen
components.notes: Use retained gfx906 database and legacy/assembly solvers.

components.name: RCCL
components.notes: Validate PCIe P2P and optional Infinity Fabric separately.

components.name: PyTorch
components.notes: Build with PYTORCH_ROCM_ARCH=gfx906; math SDPA default.

components.name: llama.cpp-HIP
components.notes: Primary supported LLM inference engine.

components.name: hipBLASLt
components.notes: Build as an explicit candidate, but rocBLAS keeps gfx906 on Tensile by default; use ROCBLAS_USE_HIPBLASLT=1 only for hardware experiments.

components.name: hipSPARSELt
components.notes: ROCm 10 ships structured-sparse MFMA logic only for newer matrix-core targets; use rocSPARSE fallback.

components.name: composable-kernel
components.notes: Investigate a wave64/gfx906 port rather than treating the current target exclusion as final.

components.name: rocWMMA
components.notes: Upstream marks gfx906 fundamentally incompatible.

components.name: hipTensor
components.notes: Audit generic tensor operators and provide gfx906 kernels where no newer matrix ISA is assumed.

components.name: aotriton-flash-attention
components.notes: Investigate a gfx906-compatible attention implementation; math SDPA remains the validated fallback.

components.name: vLLM-upstream
components.notes: Experimental fork only; not a release gate.

components.name: native-windows-rocm
components.notes: Deferred; official Windows/runtime path does not qualify MI50.
